## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and any service/API or SDK compatibility implications.

## Validation

Describe builds, offline/GUI checks and documentation checks actually run, plus
any limitations. Keep review evidence and local plans out of the commit.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Contribution follows [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and targets the agreed branch.
- [ ] Individual CLA signed; corporate authorization/CCLA supplied when required.
- [ ] Tests and Doxygen/user documentation cover the changed behavior as appropriate.
- [ ] Dependencies, copied assets and source data have compatible licenses and attribution.
- [ ] No credentials, private model/boundary data, generated docs, local plans or caches included.
- [ ] Attribution and changelog updated when applicable.
